$fixture.notes: A boundary disabled by offline recovery is immutable in-product and cannot be re-enabled through the API. This matches the backend today, where updateAccessConstraint never writes `disabled` and only the offline CLI can clear it (base inventory §2.2, §3.6) — but today the API silently round-trips the flag instead of refusing. The matching record fixture is recovery-disabled-detail.json, whose _capabilities omits commit and previewTighten.

error.message: This boundary was disabled by emergency recovery and cannot be changed here.
